title: Actuarial Worksheet: Interest Extinguished with a Whole Life Insurance Policy Loan at Offset
content:
When an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy loan is offset against the policy values, the loan principal and the loan interest are extinguished together.

## Definition

**Principal extinguished.** The ledger loan principal: the loan advances and capitalized interest on the policy ledger, less the principal repaid and extinguished.

**Interest extinguished.** The ledger loan principal multiplied by the tier's loan interest rate, simple, for the actual calendar days from the loan interest paid-to date shown on the policy to the date the offset is booked, over **365**, rounded half up to the cent.

## Lines of the worksheet

| Line | Entry | Source |
|---|---|---|
| A | Loan advances on the ledger | Loan advance entries |
| B | Capitalized interest on the ledger | Capitalization entries |
| C | Principal repaid: the amounts on the loan repayment entries | Loan repayment entries |
| D | Principal already extinguished | Loan offset entries |
| E | Ledger loan principal: A plus B, less C, less D | |
| F | Tier's loan interest rate | Tier loan terms |
| G | Days from the loan interest paid-to date to the booking date | Policy record and the booking date |
| H | Interest extinguished: E times F times G, over 365, rounded half up to the cent | |

## Worked worksheet (hypothetical, loan interest rate 6%)

Advances 15000.00; capitalized interest 900.00; repaid 2400.00; nothing extinguished before. Line E: 13500.00. Loan interest paid-to date April 1, 2025; offset booked July 11, 2025: 101 days. Line H: 13500.00 times 0.06 times 101, over 365, that is 224.1370, rounded to 224.14. Principal extinguished 13500.00, interest extinguished 224.14.
